description.value:
The Senkoh LX has made big splashes in corporate fashion circles. It looks like an expensive, brand-name accessory... and that's because it is. Arasaka partnered up with luxury clothier Jinguji to create this little wonder. The marriage of cutting-edge technology with chic corpowear has given birth to the perfect complementary piece for all of this season's top styles. But Arasaka engineers never settle for inferior performance, so expect the same precision and power as any other firearm in their arsenal.

Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Foregrip, Tech Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, the entire magazine is expended instead. While this weapon’s Tech Rebuild is charged, it is only capable of using Autofire. When worn openly, this weapon counts as an installation of Superchrome Coating. While wielded in two hands, this weapon provides its user a +1 Complementary Bonus to Aimed Shots and Autofire Checks [Excellent Quality + Foregrip].

Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Foregrip, Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
